semiconductor_relevance: High — Koyo High Precision specializes in machining difficult-to-machine materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Koyo High Precision is a machining manufacturer that focuses on high-precision processing of challenging materials such as tungsten, molybdenum, and ceramics, which are essential in semiconductor applications. The company offers mass production capabilities and advanced machining techniques to meet the stringent requirements of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: High-precision mass production of tungsten with ±3μ tolerance
High-precision finishing of materials using hard turning with ±2μ tolerance
5-axis machining and ultrasonic machining for ceramics and quartz
